newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOCCER-MASINGA GOAL GIVES SOUTH AFRICA WIN OVER ZAIRE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MASINGA GOAL GIVES SOUTH AFRICA WIN OVER ZAIRE.

text.p: Italy-based striker Phil Masinga thundered home a 72nd-minute goal to give South Africa a 1-0 win over Zaire in their World Cup African group three qualifying match in Johannesburg on Saturday.

Masinga, who plays in the Serie B for Salernitana, silenced a critical crowd of 65,000 who had been callng for his replacement by scoring from close range after a square pass from substitute Jerry Sikhosana.

The goal was a record ninth for Masinga, now South Africa's leading international goalscorer, and did much to lift an atmopshere of gloom after the African champions had laboured through the first-half.

South Africa started as strong favourites, particularly after Zaire's team arrived in the country just three hours before kick-off after their plane was delayed and caused the kick-off to be put back by 45 minutes.

Defender Mark Fish headed against the crossbar in the second minute but South Africa failed to impose themselves after that with a sluggish performance against a Zaire side without the majority of their foreign-based stars.

It was only after the introduction of Sikhosana that the team picked up the pace and the nuggety striker proved the catalyst with a clever pass that former Leeds United forward Masinga buried from close-range.
South Africa now top the table in group three with Congo and Zambia to play on Sunday in the group's other match.

South Africa: 1-Andre Arendse; 2-Sizwe Motaung, 4-Lucas Radebe, 9-Neil Tovey, 5-Mark Fish; 8-Linda Buthelezi, 21-Eric Tinkler, 10-John Moshoeu (3-David Nyathi 83rd min), 15-Doctor Khumalo (19-Helman Mkhalele 73rd); 17-Shaun Bartlett (25-Jerry Sikhosan 65th), 6-Phil Masinga.
